description: Read one live board dimension by its axis id. Prefer this when a dimension is supplied or selected at runtime; axis_* tools select one fixed dimension with no arguments. Use board_totals for the overview. Returns applicable metrics, original evidence dates and links; a leader is named only when SEPARATED. UNMEASURED is not zero or pass/fail; BAD_INPUT, NOT_ON_BOARD and UNREACHABLE remain distinct. Check the referenced method before comparing results. Measurement, not certification or permission.

axis.description: The axis name as it appears on the board, e.g. governance, safety, jail, provenance-controls. Case-insensitive. An unknown name returns the list of names the board actually carries.

name: get_axis

resolved_from.description: present when the caller named an alias (e.g. gov) that resolved to this board axis

title: One GSPC board axis
